item.title: Validator max turns (10) too low — causes false sprint failures
item.intent: Validators must have enough turns to complete verification — a validator hitting max turns is a system failure, not a code quality failure.
item.description: With MAX_TURNS_VALIDATOR=10, validators frequently hit the limit before writing result.json, causing the sprint to fail even when the developer's code passed all AC verify commands. Increase default to 15 or 20.
steps: Update CONFIGURATION.md if it documents the default
